findings.issue: The Zapatista bodies dissolved in 2023 are named 'Juntas de Buen Gobierno' (JBG) in Spanish. 'Consejos de Buen Gobierno' is a back-translation of the English gloss 'Good Government Councils' and produces an institution name Spanish-language readers will not recognise; the same entry correctly keeps 'MAREZ'.
findings.recommended_text: Una estructura de autonomía mantenida por las comunidades zapatistas en Chiapas que desde 2023 ha sustituido a los antiguos MAREZ y Juntas de Buen Gobierno por gobiernos autónomos locales, colectivos regionales y coordinación asamblearia.

findings.issue: 'bioregional' is misspelled. In Spanish orthography a prefix ending in a vowel before word-initial r doubles the r: 'biorregional' (cf. 'birregional', 'contrarreforma').
findings.recommended_text: Una red biorregional abierta que trata los Grandes Lagos como un bien común vivo y busca reforzar la gobernanza comunitaria e indígena, la responsabilidad compartida y la custodia a largo plazo del agua más allá de las fronteras políticas.

findings.issue: 'Bioregión' is misspelled; correct Spanish is 'Biorregión'.
findings.recommended_text: Biorregión de los Grandes Lagos en Canadá y Estados Unidos

findings.issue: 'bioregional' is misspelled; correct Spanish is 'biorregional'.
findings.recommended_text: Aprendizaje biorregional, creación de redes y participación para la gobernanza comunitaria del agua

findings.issue: Untranslated English administrative and country names in an otherwise Spanish label: 'Kwale County, Kenya'. The same file uses 'Kenia' in akiba-mashinani-trust and kibera-public-space-project, so this is also an internal inconsistency.
findings.recommended_text: Bahía de Gazi, condado de Kwale, Kenia — ancla costera amplia

findings.issue: 'Western Province' is left in English; it is an administrative division name, not an organisation name, and has a standard Spanish form.
findings.recommended_text: Isla de Tetepare, Provincia Occidental, Islas Salomón

findings.issue: 'Neuer St. Jacobi Cemetery' carries the English common noun 'Cemetery' into Spanish prose; the site is the German 'Neuer St. Jacobi Friedhof'. fr and pt-BR both translate the generic ('cimetière', 'cemitério').
findings.recommended_text: Huerto comunitario en el cementerio Neuer St. Jacobi

findings.issue: 'Una base de conocimiento libre de enunciados estructurados' parses naturally as 'a knowledge base free OF structured statements', i.e. the opposite of the source. The purpose relation ('for statements') is lost.
findings.recommended_text: Una base de datos de conocimiento libre para enunciados estructurados y legibles por máquina, utilizados y enlazados en los proyectos Wikimedia y en otras aplicaciones.

findings.issue: 'se amplían y mantienen con voluntarios' uses the wrong preposition for an agent; the source is 'expanded and maintained BY volunteers' ('por voluntarios').
findings.recommended_text: Un catálogo de libros abierto y editable de forma colaborativa y una biblioteca pública digital del Internet Archive cuyo software, datos y documentación son abiertos y son ampliados y mantenidos por voluntarios.

findings.issue: 'relevados' for 'surveyed' is a River Plate regionalism; in most of the Spanish-speaking world 'relevar' means 'to relieve/replace', which is misleading in a neutral-Spanish overlay.
findings.recommended_text: Una base de datos cartográfica abierta mundial cuyas carreteras, caminos y otros datos geográficos son cartografiados, corregidos y reutilizables libremente por los colaboradores.

findings.issue: 'Una comunidad internacional' drops the source's 'township' (a planned town) and collides with the fixed Spanish collocation 'la comunidad internacional' (= the international community). fr renders it correctly as 'cité internationale'.
findings.recommended_text: Una ciudad internacional en Tamil Nadu que desde 1968 experimenta con vida comunal, práctica ecológica y organización social alternativa; la tierra y los activos se mantienen legalmente a través de la Auroville Foundation en lugar de ser propiedad individual de los residentes.

findings.issue: The English 'Potato Park' is kept in the Spanish overlay although the initiative's own name in its own language is 'Parque de la Papa'; this is untranslated English rather than a canonical name for this locale.
findings.recommended_text: Comunidades del Parque de la Papa cerca de Písac, Cusco, Perú

findings.issue: 'video' is written without the accent here while wikimedia-commons in the same file uses 'vídeo'; the overlay is internally inconsistent in its neutral-Spanish spelling choice.

findings.issue: 'Software de red mallada de código abierto sin infraestructura convencional' misplaces the off-grid modifier so it reads as 'open source without conventional infrastructure' rather than as a property of the network's operation.

findings.issue: 'las residentes son dueñas' uses a feminine generic for a mixed group, while the rest of the file uses masculine generics ('los residentes', 'vecinos', 'voluntarios'). Style choice is defensible but inconsistent within the overlay.
findings.recommended_text: Un fideicomiso comunitario de tierras gestionado por ocho comunidades en San Juan que mantiene colectivamente tierras públicas mientras los residentes son dueños de sus viviendas y reciben protección a largo plazo frente al desplazamiento.

findings.issue: '1,006 hectáreas' uses the English thousands comma. It is read as a decimal separator in Spain and in RAE-recommended usage; pt-BR and fr both localised the grouping ('1.006', '1 006').
findings.recommended_text: La Pachgaon Gram Sabha gestiona 1006 hectáreas de bosque mediante derechos reconocidos de Community Forest Resource, combinando decisiones democráticas con la protección forestal y la cosecha y venta de bambú para medios de vida locales.

findings.issue: Same untranslated English common noun 'conservancies' in the digital label.

findings.issue: 'Gulu City' and 'West Nile' are left in English in a French label; both are ordinary place designations with established French forms, and es localises them ('Ciudad de Gulu', 'Nilo Occidental').

findings.issue: 'tours de travail' is not the idiomatic French for member work shifts; 'créneaux de travail' (or 'tours de service') is standard. The same wording recurs in this entry's digital_label.

findings.issue: Apostrophe typography is mixed across the fr overlay: roughly a quarter of the entries use the straight ASCII apostrophe (this entry has none, but cano-martin-pena-clt, cecosesola, cooperation-jackson, open-library, openstreetmap, wikidata, zapatista-autonomy and about eighteen others do) while the majority use the typographic ’. findings.issue: 'communautés d’habitat informel' adds 'informel', which is not in the source ('settlement communities'). The gloss is factually apt for this trust but is an addition relative to the reference text and to the other three locales.

review_notes: SHA-256 of all four target overlays was recomputed locally before review and matched the required digests exactly; en.json (reference) hashed to 97d084727349070505fc19a3fb2463c1aa3241f227821270e7e60a2a6c32bb97.

Structural check: each of es, fr, pt-BR, ar contains exactly 88 project entries with the same project ids as en.json, the same presence/absence of summary and digital_label, and identical geographic_labels key sets; no extra or missing keys were found.
Titles are absent from all four target overlays as expected; title omission was not treated as a defect.
All 88 summaries, all geographic_labels values and all digital_labels present in each locale were read in full and compared field by field against en.json.
No blocker-level defects were found: no entry is in the wrong language, and no summary was found to be materially wrong about what the project is, where it is, or who runs it.

The single major finding is es/zapatista-autonomy, where the Spanish-language institution 'Juntas de Buen Gobierno' is rendered as 'Consejos de Buen Gobierno', a back-translation from the English gloss. fr, pt-BR and ar are unaffected because 'Conseils/Conselhos/مجالس' are correct translations rather than the entity's own name.
Recurring cross-locale pattern: the 'bioregional' family is misspelled without the doubled r in both es (bioregional/Bioregión) and pt-BR (bioregional/Bioregião); fr uses 'biorégional' correctly.

Recurring cross-locale pattern: the geographic labels for mikoko-pamoja and bosco-uganda retain untranslated English administrative terms ('Kwale County', 'Gulu City', 'West Nile') in es, pt-BR and, for bosco, fr, while the surrounding text is localised.

Numeric formatting: fr ('1 006', '17 000') and pt-BR ('1.006', '17.000') localise digit grouping; es keeps the English comma ('1,006', '17,000'), which is ambiguous in neutral Spanish; ar keeps the comma, which is acceptable.

Arabic mixed-script check: most Latin-script insertions are genuine organisation or product names (Community Land Trust Brussels, Terra Concordia gGmbH, TONIBUNG, NACSO, WCS, LoRaWAN, ODbL, API, Discord, Internet Archive, Factor e Farm) and were not flagged; only 'ICT' (a translatable common-noun acronym) and 'Sanghams' (already transliterated elsewhere in the same entry) were flagged.

Arabic numeral polarity was checked across all counted expressions; the rule is applied correctly for قرى, مناطق and منازل and is violated only for مجتمعات in cano-martin-pena-clt and potato-park-peru.

The fr overlay mixes straight ASCII apostrophes and typographic ’ across roughly a quarter of its entries; this is a file-level typography inconsistency rather than a per-entry linguistic defect and is recorded as a single note.

Terminology consistency was checked per locale for recurring UI strings (the '— broad … anchor' suffixes, 'community network', 'commons', 'open source'); the only outlier serious enough to report is fr/mikoko-pamoja's 'vaste repère côtier' against the uniform 'ancrage …' pattern.
No fabricated facts, invented figures, or dropped clauses were found in any locale beyond the small additions and omissions recorded as findings (fr/akiba 'informel'; pt-BR/arvari dropped 'local').
No web sources were consulted; the review is based solely on the five files in catalog/locales/ and on internal linguistic knowledge. No file in the repository was modified.
